# A write the program makes to a control's bound value fires none of that
# control's events; only the user, or a test's trigger, does. Run on every
# target a test can execute on.
#
# Each control is bound twice: once at the root and once in Mirror, which a
# loop makes a runtime instance. A runtime instance's handler wrote the value
# back to the widget it came from, and gtk4's entry fired "changed" for that
# write, re-entering the handler until the stack overflowed; a checkbox, switch
# or radio fired its change for a write and reported it as the user's.
#
# Typing into a field fires its @input and not its @change, which is the
# commit's: android fired both from every keystroke. bubbletea's textarea had
# no commit, so a test committing one named an invoker it never wrote.

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout 'ok   5 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout 'ok   5 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok   5 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok   5 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok   5 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin app.sngl
stdout 'ok   5 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=none notes.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=html notes.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go notes.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go notes.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go notes.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin notes.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

component Mirror(:text string, :on bool, :pick string, @fired()) ui.node {
    ui.vbox {
        ui.input(:value=text, @input(v) { fired() }, @change(v) { fired() })
        ui.textarea(:value=text, @input(v) { fired() }, @change(v) { fired() })
        ui.checkbox(:checked=on, label="c", @change(c) { fired() })
        ui.toggle(:checked=on, @change(c) { fired() })
        ui.radio(:value=pick, @change(v) { fired() }) {
            ui.choice(label="a", value="a")
            ui.choice(label="b", value="b")
        }
        ui.select(:value=pick, @change(v) { fired() }) {
            ui.choice(label="a", value="a")
            ui.choice(label="b", value="b")
        }
    }
}

component main ui.node {
    var text = ""
    var on = false
    var pick = "a"
    var events = 0
    var changes = 0

    ui.vbox {
        ui.input #field(:value=text, @input(v) { events += 1 }, @change(v) { changes += 1 })
        ui.textarea #notes(:value=text, @input(v) { events += 1 }, @change(v) { changes += 1 })
        ui.checkbox #box(:checked=on, label="c", @change(c) { events += 1 })
        ui.radio(:value=pick, @change(v) { events += 1 }) {
            ui.choice(label="a", value="a")
            ui.choice(label="b", value="b")
        }
        ui.button #set(text="set", @click {
            text = "abc"
            on = true
            pick = "b"
        })
        for var i = [1] {
            Mirror(:text=text, :on=on, :pick=pick, @fired { events += 1 })
        }
    }
}

func testAProgramWriteFiresNothing(t Test, c main) {
    c.set.click()
    t.assert(c.text == "abc")
    t.assert(c.on == true)
    t.assert(c.pick == "b")
    t.assert(c.events == 0)
}

func testTypingFiresOnce(t Test, c main) {
    c.field.input("xy")
    t.assert(c.text == "xy")
    t.assert(c.events == 1)
    t.assert(c.changes == 0)
}

func testCommittingFiresChange(t Test, c main) {
    c.field.input("xy")
    c.field.change("xy")
    t.assert(c.text == "xy")
    t.assert(c.events == 1)
    t.assert(c.changes == 1)
}

func testTypingNotesFiresOnce(t Test, c main) {
    c.notes.input("xy")
    t.assert(c.text == "xy")
    t.assert(c.events == 1)
    t.assert(c.changes == 0)
}

func testCheckingFiresOnce(t Test, c main) {
    c.box.change(true)
    t.assert(c.on == true)
    t.assert(c.events == 1)
}

ui.window {
    main
}
-- notes.sngl --
import . "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

component main ui.node {
    var text = ""
    var events = 0
    var changes = 0

    ui.textarea #notes(:value=text, @input(v) { events += 1 }, @change(v) { changes += 1 })
}

func testCommittingFiresChange(t Test, c main) {
    c.notes.input("xy")
    t.assert(c.changes == 0)
    c.notes.change("xy")
    t.assert(c.text == "xy")
    t.assert(c.events == 1)
    t.assert(c.changes == 1)
}

ui.window {
    main
}
